name: Grant of Financial Assistance to the Poor Parents Having Only One Girl Child Who is Studying 8th to 10th Standard
benefit:
- ₹ 25,000/- will be deposited in a fixed deposit in the Post Office in the form of a National Savings Certificate in the name of the Girl Child.
- The maturity amount will be released when the girl child attains the age of eighteen years.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a citizen of India.
1. The applicant should be a native of Puducherry by virtue of birth or continuous residence of not less than five years.
1. The applicant should have an annual income not exceeding ₹75,000/-.
1. The applicant should have only one living girl child and no other issue.
